normalization: minimum cyclic gap g mapped to {0,g}; third selected element fixed; reflection enforces third-g <= wrap
coverage: For normalized minimum gap g and fixed third t, the fourth selected element ranges from t+g through 100-(t-g)-10g. Every later consecutive gap is at least g and the final wrap is at least t-g by reflection. The disjoint fourth-element branches therefore cover the full normalized t case.
